	# V6: a realm that may open a small feud: a realm at peace (a player realm too, Q-92: feuds are FULL only), of a feud group, free and not
	# already feuding.
	exists = yes
	has_war = no

	NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_variety_feuding }
	OR = {

		has_country_flag = zin_variety_feud_triton_lords
	}
}
zin_variety_full = {

	zin_rules_ai_branch_variety_full = yes
}

	# V6, scope: a candidate; PREV: the other realm. Both belong to one feud group.
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = zin_variety_feud_dark_holds
